versions.changelog:
0.4.4.0 - Downloading files are probed with ffprobe before playback, so Jellyfin knows
their codecs and only remuxes compatible files instead of re-encoding everything;
duration and seeking now work in the RuTracker channel.
0.4.3.0 - Fix "the process cannot access the file" in qBittorrent on Windows while
watching: the stream now reads the file without locking it (SMB mounts turned the lock
into a Windows file lock). Torrents stopped by a file error are resumed automatically.
0.4.2.0 - "Разрешить канал всем с ролью «Поиск»" button: adds the RuTracker channel to
the allowed channels of users whose Jellyfin profile does not allow channels.
0.4.1.0 - "Проверить канал и папки" button: shows which users see the RuTracker channel
and why not, and whether Jellyfin can write to the download folders. Write errors
(e.g. a read-only mount) are logged once instead of every few seconds.
0.4.0.0 - Watch while downloading: "RuTracker" channel lists active downloads and
plays episodes as soon as their pieces arrive (the played episode jumps to the front).
Each release gets its own "Title (Year)" folder; unfinished files are hidden with a
.ignore file; "copy after download" mode implemented; finished episodes appear in the
library immediately. Starting episode can be chosen for magnet-only topics. Search
now shows the "[Док] Разное / некондиция" forum and other "[Док]" forums.
0.3.0.0 - Downloads through qBittorrent: "Смотреть" button with type, folder and
starting episode; whole torrent downloaded in watching order (chosen episode first);
downloads tab with progress, episode switching and cancel.
0.2.6.0 - Search page: sorting by seeders, torrent date and size; subtitles filter;
multi-select filters by forum and uploader; uploader shown in results.
0.2.5.0 - Add Cloudflare cf_clearance support and matching browser User-Agent.
0.2.4.0 - Fix Cyrillic search: the query string is sent in UTF-8; the connection
check now searches a Cyrillic title; no needless re-login when the session is valid.
0.2.3.0 - Connection check also tests the search page; password login pauses for
15 minutes after RuTracker refuses it; clearer message when the cookie stops working.
0.2.2.0 - RuTracker login now opens the login page first (service cookies, hidden
form fields, captcha detection) like a browser; clearer login diagnostics.
0.2.1.0 - Alternative RuTracker address with automatic fallback; detection of
ISP block pages; step-by-step connection checks for RuTracker and qBittorrent.
0.2.0.0 - RuTracker search page and a header button in the web client;
admin check of RuTracker login.
0.1.0.0 - Plugin skeleton, configuration, path mapping, role-based access.
